channel.title: Daily Social Trends
channel.description: Daily raw social trends across Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest, whittled from 100+ candidates to 25 new trends by virality, growth rate and sentiment, plus up to 5 Signals (still trending after 1 week) and up to 5 Evergreens (still trending after 2 weeks, expiring after 3 weeks). Client tags are filters for the reader, not a filter on the feed.
